269: #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
270: pub enum RuntimeError {
271:     /// Stable runtime-facing invalid-state errors intended to map cleanly to ABI status
272:     /// responses.
273:     DuplicateBody(BodyId),
274:     UnknownBody(BodyId),
275:     UnknownScenario(ScenarioId),
276:     InvalidEpochDelta(f64),
277:     InvalidPlaybackRate(f64),
278:     AdvanceBusy,
279:     AdvanceStale,
280:     AdvanceWorkLimit,
281:     UnknownCheckpoint(CheckpointId),
282:     DuplicateCheckpoint(CheckpointId),
283:     DuplicateBranch(BranchId),
284:     PackagePlanFailed(UpdatePlanError),
285:     PackageApplyFailed(ApplyUpdateError),
286:     NoInstalledManifestAvailable,
287:     PackageNotInstalled(String),
288:     MountedPackageMissingFromStore(String),
289: }
290: 
291: #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
292: pub struct ApplyUpdateManifestCommand {
293:     /// One explicit package update transaction request.
294:     /// Runtime owns package manifests and update application details; this is the
295:     /// immutable input boundary.
296:     pub manifest: UpdateManifest,
297:     pub target: CompatibilityTarget,
298:     pub fetched_packages_by_id: BTreeMap<String, StoredPackage>,
299: }

301: #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
302: pub struct MountPackageCommand {
303:     /// Opaque package identity request from shells to mark installed data as mounted.
304:     pub package_id: String,
305: }

1289:     fn command_kind(&self, command: &WorldCommand) -> String {
1290:         match command {
1291:             WorldCommand::SeedCanonicalSolarSystem => "catalog.seed_canonical_solar_system",
1292:             WorldCommand::SpawnBody { .. } => "body.spawn",
1293:             WorldCommand::RemoveBody { .. } => "body.remove",
1294:             WorldCommand::SetBodyKinematics { .. } => "body.set_kinematics",
1295:             WorldCommand::AdvanceEpoch { .. } => "timeline.advance_epoch",
1296:             WorldCommand::PausePlayback => "playback.pause",
1297:             WorldCommand::ResumePlayback => "playback.resume",
1298:             WorldCommand::SetPlaybackRate { .. } => "playback.set_rate",
1299:             WorldCommand::SetObserverMode { .. } => "observer.set_mode",
1300:             WorldCommand::FocusBody { .. } => "observer.focus_body",
1301:             WorldCommand::CreateCheckpoint { .. } => "history.create_checkpoint",
1302:             WorldCommand::CreateBranchFromCheckpoint { .. } => {
1303:                 "history.create_branch_from_checkpoint"
1304:             }
1305:         }
1306:         .to_owned()
1307:     }
1308: 
1309:     fn command_summary(&self, command: &WorldCommand) -> String {
1310:         match command {
1311:             WorldCommand::SeedCanonicalSolarSystem => "seed canonical startup solar system".into(),
1312:             WorldCommand::SpawnBody { body } => format!("spawn {}", body.body_id.0),
1313:             WorldCommand::RemoveBody { body_id } => format!("remove {}", body_id.0),
1314:             WorldCommand::SetBodyKinematics { body_id, .. } => {
1315:                 format!("set kinematics {}", body_id.0)
1316:             }
1317:             WorldCommand::AdvanceEpoch { delta_seconds } => {
1318:                 format!("advance epoch by {:.3}s", delta_seconds)
1319:             }
1320:             WorldCommand::PausePlayback => "pause playback".into(),
1321:             WorldCommand::ResumePlayback => "resume playback".into(),
1322:             WorldCommand::SetPlaybackRate {
1323:                 sim_seconds_per_real_second,
1324:             } => format!("set playback rate {:.3}", sim_seconds_per_real_second),
1325:             WorldCommand::SetObserverMode { mode } => format!("set observer mode {mode:?}"),
1326:             WorldCommand::FocusBody { body_id } => {
1327:                 let target = body_id.as_ref().map_or("none", |id| id.0.as_str());
1328:                 format!("focus {target}")
1329:             }
1330:             WorldCommand::CreateCheckpoint {
1331:                 checkpoint_id,
1332:                 label,
1333:             } => {
1334:                 let id = checkpoint_id.as_ref().map_or("auto", |v| v.0.as_str());
1335:                 let note = label.as_deref().unwrap_or("unlabeled");
1336:                 format!("checkpoint {id} ({note})")
1337:             }
1338:             WorldCommand::CreateBranchFromCheckpoint {
1339:                 checkpoint_id,
1340:                 new_branch_id,
1341:             } => {
1342:                 let id = new_branch_id.as_ref().map_or("auto", |v| v.0.as_str());
1343:                 format!("branch {id} from {}", checkpoint_id.0)
1344:             }
1345:         }
1346:     }
1347:

3327:     #[test]
3328:     fn branch_snapshot_reports_origin_checkpoint() {
3329:         let mut runtime = new_runtime();
3330:         let checkpoint_events = runtime
3432:                 .apply_command(
3433:                     WorldCommand::SetPlaybackRate {
3434:                         sim_seconds_per_real_second: value,
3435:                     },
3436:                     3,
3437:                 )
3438:                 .expect_err("invalid playback rate must fail");
3439:             assert!(
3440:                 matches!(err, RuntimeError::InvalidPlaybackRate(v) if v.to_bits() == value.to_bits())
3441:             );
3442:             assert_eq!(runtime.snapshot(), before);
3443:             assert_eq!(runtime.next_command_ordinal, ordinal);
3444:         }
3445: 
3446:         runtime
3447:             .apply_command(
3448:                 WorldCommand::SetPlaybackRate {
3449:                     sim_seconds_per_real_second: 2.0,
3450:                 },
3451:                 4,
3452:             )
3453:             .unwrap();
3454:         runtime
3455:             .apply_command(
3456:                 WorldCommand::AdvanceEpoch {
3457:                     delta_seconds: 30.0,
3458:                 },
3459:                 5,
3460:             )
3461:             .unwrap();
3462:         assert_eq!(runtime.snapshot().playback.sim_seconds_per_real_second, 2.0);
3463:         assert_eq!(runtime.snapshot().epoch_seconds, 30.0);
3464:     }

3466:     #[test]
3467:     fn rejects_unrepresentable_advance_before_mutation_but_allows_empty_world_jumps() {
3468:         let mut runtime = new_runtime();
3469:         runtime
3470:             .apply_command(
3471:                 WorldCommand::AdvanceEpoch {
3472:                     delta_seconds: f64::MAX,
3473:                 },
3474:                 1,
3475:             )
4327:             .apply_command(
4328:                 WorldCommand::SetPlaybackRate {
4329:                     sim_seconds_per_real_second: 0.0,
4330:                 },
4331:                 2,
4332:             )
4333:             .expect_err("zero playback rate must fail");
4334: 
4335:         assert_eq!(err, RuntimeError::InvalidPlaybackRate(0.0));
4336:     }

4338:     #[test]
4339:     fn rejects_duplicate_checkpoint_ids_across_branches() {
4340:         let mut runtime = new_runtime();
4341:         let checkpoint_id = CheckpointId("manual-dup".into());
4342: 
4343:         runtime
4344:             .apply_command(
4345:                 WorldCommand::CreateCheckpoint {
4346:                     checkpoint_id: Some(checkpoint_id.clone()),
4347:                     label: None,
4348:                 },
4349:                 1,
4350:             )
4351:             .expect("initial checkpoint should succeed");
4352: 
4353:         let err = runtime
4354:             .apply_command(
4355:                 WorldCommand::CreateCheckpoint {
4356:                     checkpoint_id: Some(checkpoint_id.clone()),
4357:                     label: None,
4358:                 },
4359:                 2,
4360:             )
4361:             .expect_err("duplicate checkpoint id must fail");
4362: 
4363:         assert_eq!(err, RuntimeError::DuplicateCheckpoint(checkpoint_id));
4364:     }
